value.basis: Kessels et al. (2000) norms and later computerized/eCorsi studies give young-adult forward block spans of roughly 6.0–6.5 (SD ~1.1–1.4) under a nearly identical protocol (1 s per block, two trials per length, span = longest length with one correct); unproctored online mouse responding and the stopping rule tend to shave a few tenths off, while the 3–10 range introduces no meaningful floor or ceiling in this population.
